title: I Lost my Mind
reviewNotes: All 16 saved states and captions reviewed. Native image 8 establishes the complete five-piece position after Kc5 at 12s: White Kc5/c4 versus Black Kd7/Qf3/Qe2, Black to move. The source Qb2 is actual stalemate. Two explicitly independent Qb3 alternatives leave exactly Kd4 or Kd5 and reach actual Qbxc4 mate. Three branches, seven distinct tablebase positions, seven encoded moves. Earlier game play is outside the verified scope.
